title: Angleton and others on George C. Marshall's team

tellings.quote: find is a lot of this cast of characters, including James Jesus Angleton, who went on to become the key person at the CIA, they all seem to have been part of General George C. Marshall's team

plain: A researcher named Pippa Malmgren, appearing on Jesse Michels's podcast with her father Harald, a former presidential adviser, says that many of the figures she studies all seem to have worked on the team of General George C. Marshall, a senior US Army leader, in the years from 1945 into the 1950s. Among them, she says, was James Jesus Angleton, who went on to become a key figure at the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency. If so, it would point to one shared circle of people behind the later handling of these secrets.
